body.statement: For sample sizes in the deterministic eventual regime \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M}T_n(P)\ge T_0\), uniformly over the instrumental strengthened subclass \(P\in\mathcal M\), the quantitative condition \(\mathsf G_n\) yields \(\{S_n(\theta)-S_n^{\circ}\}/a(T_n(P))\to0\) in probability. The oracle statistic admits a coupling with \(\{S_n^{\circ}-M_{T_n(P)}\}/a(T_n(P))\to0\), with common constrained and unconstrained contact localization, locally frozen coefficients glued by \(T_n(P)\), and an asymptotically equivalent maximum over the two one-sided limits in each empirical dose cell. Consequently, uniformly for \(x\) in compact sets, \(\Pr_P\{[S_n(\theta)-b(T_n(P))]/a(T_n(P))\le x\}\to\exp\{-e^{-x}\}\). At one fixed dose the construction recovers Doss's (2026) pointwise LR limit, while the continuum coupling and eventual-regime Gumbel law strictly strengthen that fixed-dose result on \(\mathcal M\).
body.justification: The canonical theorem becomes causal inference only after the displayed Gumbel-scale threshold is verified and the actual optimized cross-fitted statistic is transferred on the instrumental smooth subclass.
body.gap: Doss (2026) proves a fixed-dose LR limit under pointwise remainder conditions, while Westling and Carone (2020) prove pointwise primitive transfer; neither controls a continuum maximum at its moving threshold or asserts the global fixed-radius subclass used here.
body.consumer: This delivers joint profile calibration for the interior nurse-hours--readmission curve rather than a collection of pointwise LR intervals.

obligation.what_is_open: A single uniform coupling of the optimized oracle continuum statistic to the canonical maximum on the growing spatial clock remains unavailable.
obligation.obstruction: The theorem requires a measurable strong approximation of sorted residuals, random rank and variance-clock interpolation, common constrained and unconstrained contact localization, local coefficient freezing, overlap gluing, and empirical dose-cell comparison at a moving maximum. Pointwise LR convergence and the frozen remainder quantities do not supply this joint growing-domain result.
obligation.attempted: The local cube-root rescaling and its exact spatial-volume integral were derived. A global quadratic approximation was rejected because coefficient freezing is valid only on local windows and no uniform gluing estimate has been established.
obligation.partial_result:
The local canonical spatial factor is determined algebraically.  For \(a\in J\), define
\[
 h_n(a)=\left\{\frac{4\kappa(a)}{n f(a)\theta'(a)^2}\right\}^{1/3}.
\]
Then
\[
 \frac1{h_n(a)}
 =n^{1/3}\left\{\frac{f(a)\theta'(a)^2}{4\kappa(a)}\right\}^{1/3},
 \qquad
 \int_J\frac{da}{h_n(a)}=T_n(P).
\]
Normalization of \(p\), strict overlap, the derivative bounds, and the variance bounds imply fixed positive upper and lower bounds on \(h_n(a)n^{1/3}\).  Hence the coordinate map \(a\mapsto\int_{\inf J}^a h_n(v)^{-1}\,dv\) is uniformly bi-Lipschitz after the factor \(n^{1/3}\) is removed and maps \(J\) to a canonical interval of length exactly \(T_n(P)\).  This proves the proposed spatial-volume clock conditional on a local oracle LR approximation.  It does not provide the required growing-domain coupling, which still requires a measurable strong approximation, common constrained and unconstrained contact localization, locally uniform coefficient freezing and overlap gluing, and a comparison between empirical dose-cell constraints and the continuum split constraint at a moving level of order \(\log n\).
